name: Explore Your Environment (E.Y.E.)
street_address: Victory Park Warming House, 224 Brock Avenue
description_short: A small group bike program in New Bedford's South End for ages 9 to 14: kids learn safe riding, then cycle to parks, beaches, landmarks and the Victory Park children's garden, learning local ecology and history along the way. Kids must already know how to ride.

sessions.name: Afternoon program (open to the Greater New Bedford community)

notes: Afternoon program 1:00 to 3:30, listed as 4 sessions over August 3 to 7, 2026. A morning program (9 to 12, July to August, 8 sessions) serves partnered New Bedford Public Schools youth. The page lists cost as $150 per session for both, with scholarships. Snacks provided. Groups of up to 12, 3 to 1 ratio.
